name: Register the FSx for Lustre repository for the suite that matches the OS release

tasks.name: Install the repository signing key
commands: apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 install -y gpg wget lsb-release

tasks.name: Add the suite that matches the OS release
Report the module packages the repository offers for this suite
commands: echo '--- highest module package for each kernel series ---'
apt-cache search '^lustre-client-modules-[0-9]' | awk '{print $1}' | sed 's/lustre-client-modules-//' | sort -V | tail -20
